reason_code_descriptions.both-shm-locators: Both endpoints announce a SHM locator. On the same host Fast DDS then uses the shared memory transport exclusively for user data (discovery still goes over UDP).
reason_code_descriptions.common-udpv4-locator: The reader announces a UDPv4 locator and the writer speaks UDPv4.
reason_code_descriptions.datasharing-disabled-writer: The writer announces data-sharing OFF (explicitly disabled, or AUTO resolved to OFF because the type is unbounded / the history memory policy is not preallocated).
reason_code_descriptions.measured-shm-traffic: Statistics show RTPS packets from the writer's participant to the reader's SHM locator.
reason_code_descriptions.measured-udpv4-traffic: Statistics show RTPS packets from the writer's participant to the reader's UDPv4 locator.
reason_code_descriptions.no-matching-reader: No subscription was discovered for this topic.
reason_code_descriptions.no-matching-writer: No publisher was discovered for this topic.
reason_code_descriptions.reader-no-shm-locator: The reader's participant announces no SHM locator: SHM transport is not instantiated on its side (e.g. FASTDDS_BUILTIN_TRANSPORTS=UDPv4, or an XML profile without SHM).
reason_code_descriptions.same-host-guid: Writer and reader GUID prefixes share the same first 4 bytes, which is how Fast DDS decides both participants run on the same host.
reason_code_descriptions.stats-writer-instance-limit-suspected: The writer's participant reports traffic to 10 or more locators but none to this reader. The Fast DDS statistics DataWriter keeps the default resource limit of 10 instances (one per destination locator), so counters for further locators are never published. Raise it with a data_writer XML profile named after the alias used in FASTDDS_STATISTICS (RTPS_SENT_TOPIC) whose <resourceLimitsQos> sets max_instances to 0; the package ships config/statistics.xml for this.
reason_code_descriptions.writer-no-shm-locator: The writer's participant announces no SHM locator: SHM transport is not instantiated on its side (e.g. FASTDDS_BUILTIN_TRANSPORTS=UDPv4, or an XML profile without SHM).
